run_render_jax_stubs: run the script to render Jinja templates for JAX library type stubs
render_jax_numpy_stubs: render type stubs for jax.numpy functions using Jinja templates and template helpers
render_jax_nn_stubs: render type stubs for jax.nn functions using Jinja templates and template helpers
render_jax_core_stubs: render type stubs for jax core module by excluding numpy, nn, and Array from Any annotations
generate_unannotated_stubs: generate Any-annotated stubs for unannotated jax.numpy and jax.nn functions discovered via dir()
